long_biography.plain_text:
The proposed restructuring of an Abu Dhabi investment company would place Saleh alongside one other equal partner in First Avenue Investments. It replaced a sole-proprietor model with a limited-liability company and set planned capital at AED 150,000. No management title accompanied the proposed partnership.

Saleh also held nearly four per cent of listed insurer HAYAH at the end of 2024. The stake appeared in a board-related securities table, although he was not among the insurer's directors or executives. Current market data continues to list the position. Together, these interests indicate investment activity, but neither identifies a controlling interest, day-to-day responsibility or holdings through companies, trusts and nominees. His acquisition funding and wider portfolio remain unresolved.
